BikeProfile.title: BikeProfile
BikeProfile.description: Rider's Honda CB350RS profile, odometer, paired Bluetooth device metadata, and saved navigation shortcuts.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the bike owner.

nickname.description: Custom rider nickname for the motorcycle.

plateNumber.description: Optional license plate or registration number.

odometerKm.description: Current recorded odometer reading in kilometers.

pairedDeviceName.description: Last paired Bluetooth cluster or OBD adapter name.

pairedDeviceAddress.description: Last paired Bluetooth hardware MAC address.

homeAddress.description: Saved home destination for quick turn-by-turn launch.

serviceCenterName.description: Preferred Honda BigWing or service workshop destination.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the bike profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ServiceRecord.title: ServiceRecord
ServiceRecord.description: Motorcycle maintenance and service log entry for Honda CB350RS interval tracking.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

title.description: Short summary of the service performed.

category.description: Maintenance category used to compute CB350RS factory service intervals.

odometerKm.description: Odometer reading in km at the time of service.

serviceDate.description: Date of service in YYYY-MM-DD format.

workshopName.description: Optional workshop or Honda BigWing service center name.

notes.description: Optional notes, parts replaced, or oil grade details.

DiagnosticLog.title: DiagnosticLog
DiagnosticLog.description: Vehicle ECU diagnostic snapshot captured over Bluetooth OBD-II or manual pre-ride inspection.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

engineTempC.description: Engine or oil temperature in degrees Celsius.

rpmPeak.description: Recorded RPM reading during diagnostic check.

odometerKm.description: Odometer reading in km at snapshot time.

dtcCodes.description: Bounded list of up to 20 OBD-II DTC fault codes.

/users/{userId}/serviceRecords/{recordId.description: User-scoped CB350RS maintenance and service history logs.

/users/{userId}/diagnosticLogs/{logId}.description: User-scoped OBD-II and vehicle health diagnostic snapshots.
